metadata.scenario: A woman calls for the first time asking about in-home physical therapy for her elderly father. She asks about pricing and availability. The receptionist provides a quote for three visits per week. The caller sounds relieved and says she'll call back to confirm. First-time caller, prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, my name is Sarah. I’m calling to inquire about in-home physical therapy for my elderly father. Absolutely, Sarah. I’d be happy to assist you with that. Can I ask if he has a specific condition we should be aware of? Yes, he recently had hip surgery and needs help with rehab. Got it. We offer physical therapy services tailored for recovery. Our physical therapist is available Monday through Friday. That sounds good. What would the pricing be for three visits a week? For physical therapy, our rates are between $110 to $140 per session. So, for three visits, it would range from $330 to $420 weekly. Okay, that’s helpful. And how soon could we get started with the sessions? We can usually arrange for a first visit within a few days, depending on the therapist's schedule. Oh, that sounds great! I’ll need to discuss this with my father first. Of course, please take your time. If you decide to proceed, I can assist you with the scheduling and any other questions you might have. Thank you. That would be really helpful! Is there anything else I should know in the meantime? We can also set up a care plan that includes medication management or personal care if needed. That’s good to know. I’ll keep that in mind. Perfect! Just give us a call back when you’re ready, and I’ll be here to help. I will do that. Thank you for your assistance, Margaret! You’re very welcome, Sarah. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
